title: Active listening and uncovering the real need

videos.script: Renata stops Lívia in the corridor. We need a recommendations service, like the big retailers have. Can you scope it? {{title}} Ten seconds later Lívia has an estimate. A quarter of work, two teams. And she has heard nothing Renata said after the word recommendations. {{corridor}} What Renata said next was the problem. The basket has been falling for months, and everybody upstairs is asking why. {{problem}} This lesson is about hearing that second sentence. Saying back what you understood, and letting the other person correct it. {{paraphrase}} Asking questions that open, before the ones that close. {{funnel}} And finding the need under the request. In this case it took two days to fix, not a quarter. {{iceberg}}
